en.headline: M+ opens designated exhibitions free today for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The museum at West Kowloon offers free admission to most galleries from 10am to 8pm on Sunday, excluding two special exhibitions, as part of its anniversary celebrations.
body: M+ is marking five years since its opening by offering free admission to designated exhibitions on Sunday, 8 November, from 10am to 8pm. Last entry is at 7pm, and no advance registration is required for the free galleries.

The offer covers several permanent and collection displays, including the M+ Sigg Collection: From Revolution to Globalisation, Things, Spaces, Interactions, Making It Matters, and others. It does not include the special exhibitions Design Ah! Experience the Wonder of Everyday Design and Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia.

The museum said visitors should enter via the Artist Square entrance. Members, patrons and ticket holders for the special exhibitions may use the Art Park entrance. Free screenings are also available at the Mediatheque and Grand Stair.
The free day forms part of an eight-day programme of film screenings, performances and workshops that began on 1 November. M+ has recorded more than 12.5 million visitors since opening in 2021.

zh.headline: M+五周年今日指定展覽免費開放
zh.dek: 西九文化區M+今日（8日）上午10時至晚上8時免費開放指定展覽，特別展覽除外，最後入場時間為晚上7時。
body: M+為慶祝開館五周年，今日（11月8日）上午10時至晚上8時免費開放指定展覽。最後入場時間為晚上7時，免費展覽毋須預先登記。
免費範圍包括多個常設及藏品展覽，如「M+希克藏品」相關展廳、「物件·空間·互動」、「造物記」等。兩個特別展覽「設計啊！感受日常設計之奇妙」及「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」不設免費入場。
館方表示，訪客可經藝術廣場入口進館。會員、贊助人及持特別展覽門票的人士則可使用藝術公園入口。多媒體中心及大台階當日亦有免費放映節目。
免費開放是為期八天慶祝活動的一部分，活動自11月1日開始，包括電影放映、表演及工作坊。M+自2021年開館以來已接待超過1,250萬人次訪客。
